title: Aquaculture Minimalist Armor
description: This is a resource pack meant to work with Aquaculture and Minimalist Armor! Makes the armor in Aquaculture more SMP and streamer friendly.
body:
This is a resource pack I made for a server I was a part of called KingdomSMP! It was designed to be compatible with any Minimalist Armor resource pack, though I find myself using CountXD's the most! I might make a more updated version later, since I haven't touched this in a while, but I thought I'd share it with everyone!
I don't update this regularly, so please feel free to edit it as you need, just credit me if you decide to upload your edits!
All credit for the original armor goes to Shadowclaimr from the mod Aquaculture!
